core_model: Seven primitives, not twelve. (1) Watch clock: elapsedWatches on WorldState plus one advance_watches effect (domain/simulation/WorldState.ts, WorldEffectReducer.ts). (2) Act: the single ground-truth event record {id, actorId, verb, objectRef, motiveTag, spaceId, watch, perceptibility}; appended to a bounded ring StateSlice (domain/simulation/Act.ts). Effects carry an optional causeActId through a wrapper envelope, not a new field on each of 17 variants. (3) Observation: one sparse table that replaces Report, Trace and Belief-source. Row {actId|claimId, holderId (player | faction | tracked entity), channelId, strength, confidence, learnedWatch, hops, spoofSignature?}. A Report is an Observation with channel latency. A Trace is a faction-held Observation that decays. A Belief is an Observation whose holder is an entity and which carries a Claim. Fact is not stored: it is an Act or a derived world query. Claim is a proposition reference with optional truth link (domain/simulation/Observation.ts). (4) Presence function: pure (entityId, watch, seed) -> placement (domain/simulation/Presence.ts; materialize step in application). (5) ThreadRuntime + ResourceLedger: ordinary StateSlices registered by the epoch pack, with thresholds and profiles in blueprints (domain/registries). (6) LineBrief + gate(line, brief): pure functions that read Observations; no stored state (domain/text/). (7) TextSourcePort: application port; authored, pool and generated adapters live in infrastructure and content, and output freezes into ConversationHistory. Act and Observation are not duplicates: Act is truth, Observation is who learned what. Storage is bounded: Tier 3 holds none, Tier 2 holds on demand, and epoch end compacts into legacy scars.
order: 1 Clock decision record plus elapsedWatches and advance_watches, additive. 2 Rename *Ticks to *Watches while they have no users. 3 Effect envelope with optional causeActId, so existing call sites stay green. 4 Act ring slice plus a behavior commit that emits Acts and effects. 5 Observation table and a derived discovery view, with set_discovery_layer kept as a shim. 6 Presence function, materialize on room entry, off-stage start. 7 Data profiles for instruments and decay keys, replacing the hardcoded 0.25 factor. 8 ThreadRuntime, pillar relations, ResourceLedger, EmergencyRuntime. 9 Closed-form diffusion and the evidence-coverage eval. 10 LineBrief, gate, TextSourcePort, pool authoring kit; runtime model last, behind a timing spike. Each step adds beside shipped code and removes the old path only after consumers move.

findings.change: Add one point: clock tick units and the 60 FPS seconds loop stay separate. Watches advance only through an effect, never through frame dt. Keep worldTick as a serial.
findings.note: Foundation for everything else. Renaming now is cheap. Saves need a snapshot version bump and a migration for worldTick-stamped scars.

findings.change: Do not add actor/cause to each WorldEffect variant. Use an envelope {effect, causeActId?} at applyWorldEffects. Act is the ground-truth record and is a bounded ring. Perceptibility is a data key. BehaviorModule commit returns WorldEffect[] plus an Act.
findings.layer: domain/simulation/Act.ts; BehaviorModule contract in domain; behaviors in content
findings.note: Core primitive. An optional field keeps shipped call sites green. The ring is capped (e.g. 256) and older Acts compact into legacy scars or Observations at epoch end, which bounds save size.

findings.change: Collapse Fact/Claim/Belief and Report/Trace into one sparse Observation table. Facts are not stored. Only tracked holders (player, factions, Tier 1, Tier 2 on demand) get rows. Tier 3 holds none and is derived from presence. Cap rows per holder with confidence decay and eviction.
findings.note: A dense 500x claims Belief table would blow up the save and the per-write cost. See the performance note on set_state_slice below.

findings.change: Add that the TextSourcePort returns a frozen record keyed by (briefHash, seed). Replay then reads the stored text and never regenerates it.
findings.layer: application port; adapters in infrastructure (generated) and content (authored/pool)
findings.note: Domain never imports a model. Generated text must not feed back into WorldState, which is the right determinism firewall. Retiring change 08 as designed fits P2.

findings.change: Make the pool-first, authoring-time-heavy hybrid the default. The runtime model is optional, cached in the save, and only for non-spine filler after a timing spike on the real Mac.
findings.note: Matches 60 FPS and 16 GB limits with Three.js resident. Seeded pool selection is bit-exact across machines, while WASM or WebGPU sampling is not.

findings.change: Keep LineBrief and gate as pure functions that derive from Observations and blueprints. Do not store a brief.
findings.layer: domain/text (LineBrief, gate, VoiceProfile schema); VoiceProfile data in content
findings.note: The gate runs at authoring time over pools and is cheap at runtime. The review-queue log goes to the existing session logger via a port.

findings.change: Make tellProfile a data-driven transform list with a pure, deterministic post-pass. Tag rival spoofSignature on Observations rather than on separate Reports.
findings.layer: domain schema in EpochBlueprints (RivalCivBlueprint); post-pass in domain/text
findings.note: Fits spoofMode. Doing the pass after any model step keeps the tells reliable.

findings.change: Add an authored/pooled/templated split as a field on each text slot kind, so the registry enforces it.
findings.layer: content (bibles, pools); authoring kit in tools/ outside layered src
findings.note: Mainly authoring policy. The kit must write schema-validated content files only.

findings.change: Drop Report as its own primitive. A remote Act reaches the player as an Observation with a channel latency. Rival agendas emit Acts through the storyteller, and the invariant becomes the coverage eval (RA4).
findings.layer: domain (Observation); agenda data in RivalCivBlueprint; eval under eval/
findings.note: Matches the owner rule 'aware at some point'. It reuses ChannelMediumBlueprint latency and interception fields.

findings.change: Run diffusion inside the advance_watches reducer path as a pure, bounded pass, with a cost cap per watch. Wall-clock storyteller release must be seeded from the clock and logged, or replay diverges. Prefer releasing on player-visible time units, not wall time.
findings.layer: domain pure function; scheduled by application
findings.note: Wall-clock input is the determinism risk: record each release as an effect in the session log so replay reads it.

findings.change: Compute presence from a pure function over the entity, watch, and seed. Materialize on room entry or watch jump. Resolve in-flight stimuli by a defined rule: drop the non-persistent ones, finish the closed-form catch-up as Acts.
findings.note: Starting entities off-stage via off_stage_region is a good seam. The cost is O(entities) only on a jump, not per frame.

findings.change: Derive notebook entries from the player's Observations, not from a parallel store. Omission rows require a referent stored in the Observation.
findings.note: Keeps one source of truth. Player hypotheses are the only new player-authored state, kept as a small slice.

findings.change: Build the hubs in order: clock, effect envelope, Act ring, Observation, then ThreadRuntime and ResourceLedger as slices. Land no further leaf reducer cases until each has an Act producer.
findings.layer: domain slices registered by the epoch pack
findings.note: Aligns with S1-R6 freeze. Slices avoid new top-level WorldState fields.

findings.change: Instrument profiles are data in the epoch pack: {stockDeltas, discoveryFloor, scar?}. The reducer reads a profile registry via the pack, with the three defaults retained.
findings.layer: domain schema + registry; profile values in content
findings.note: Removes the 0.25 hardcode in the reducer. Epoch-agnostic and plug-and-play.

findings.change: Make discovery a decaying evidence score, the Trace side of Observation. Decay is applied inside advance_watches using per-pack keys. Forged instruments must not jump straight to attributed. Route them through strength.
findings.note: Decay is O(rows) per watch, so it is cheap. Add a loops table to the notes as proposed.

findings.change: Keep bearsOnThreadId and supportedBy as additive optional fields on InertiaPillar. Inertia is derived from the live pillars on demand, not stored. A Leverage Chain is a pure query, memoized per watch.
findings.layer: domain/registries/EpochBlueprints.ts schema; query in domain; ThreadRuntime slice
findings.note: Optional fields keep shipped content valid. Derived inertia avoids a second source of truth.

findings.change: Add one more rule: effect validation returns rejection results, not throws, at the player-verb boundary. Keep throws for programmer errors.
findings.layer: DESIGN_NOTES / openspec; code in domain reducer result type
findings.note: A rejection result is replay-safe and testable. The reducer's current per-effect WorldEffectSchema.parse should stay at the boundary only.

findings.change: Have insertion spend Delta via the existing spend_orbital_delta path, returning a rejection outside zenith. Re-key discovery by observer through Trace rows.
findings.note: Diegetic tells are presentation. They go to content/scene and are driven by derived values.

findings.change: EmergencyRuntime goes into a slice, with scope as a list of lineage or space ids. Compounding reads the blueprint rate and applies only to in-scope entities. Allow multiple emergencies keyed by id, or decide one and document it.
findings.note: Fixes the present global compounding bug. Stays within the effect pattern.

routes.change: Use the merged Observation table. Bound per holder. Gossip becomes a pure per-watch pass over tracked holders only, not all 500.
routes.note: Save size and clone cost rule out a dense per-character table. Note that StateSliceStore.withSlice and set_state_slice call structuredClone on every write, so a big slice rewritten per effect is a 60 FPS risk. Store the table as a single slice updated once per watch batch, or add a structural-sharing path for the slice before building it.

routes.change: Drop observer rendering as a stored list. Compute witnesses from presence and perceptibility at commit time and write Observations only for tracked holders.
routes.layer: domain Act + commit step in application
routes.note: Same data as drives and pillars via motiveTag, which keeps content epoch-agnostic.

routes.change: The autonomy budget is a pack data key. The diffusion pass uses seeded RNG from state, never Math.random or wall clock.
routes.layer: domain pure pass; scheduled in application
routes.note: Deterministic and bounded. Keep the 2-hop cascade for embodied reaction only.

routes.change: Make the weight threshold and N a per-epoch data key. Include it in the eval suite under eval/, not verify.
routes.note: The only automated check of the owner's awareness rule, and the eval runner already supports it. It needs Acts and Observations to exist first.

routes.change: Keep set_discovery_layer as a shim that derives from Traces, then remove it once consumers move. Layers are threshold data per pack.
routes.note: Replaces the global scalar and gives observer-keyed discovery. Decay per watch is cheap.

routes.change: Start with global stocks and add a district key only when content uses it (S1-R6 freeze). Tells are authored per stock, three each, read from derived thresholds.
routes.layer: domain reducer + pack data; tells in content/scene
routes.note: Per-district stocks are generality ahead of use right now. Model flows with a half-life as decay keys.

routes.change: Deck draws use the SeededRandom state in WorldState, and each draw is logged as an effect. Thread phase is a field in the ThreadRuntime slice. The pacing lab runs the same function headless.
routes.layer: domain pure draw function; storyteller scheduling in application; F3 lab in interfaces
routes.note: Threads advance only by drawn beat or player verb, which matches P4 and keeps replay stable.

routes.change: Grammar rules are Zod-validated data. Expansion is a pure function of (grammar, seed, brief). The terminals are committed curated files, never model output at runtime.
routes.note: Cheap and deterministic. It fits the hybrid default in S2-05.

routes.change: Defer. Rank pool candidates with deterministic lexical or tag scoring from the brief first. Add an embedder only if the scoring is demonstrably too weak, and then only behind the TextSourcePort with the selection cached in the save.
routes.note: Embedding scores can differ across WASM or WebGPU backends, which breaks replay unless the choice is frozen. It also costs RAM beside Three.js. The model is an optimisation here, not a core primitive.

routes.change: Make the proposition struct the contract shared by all three sources. The deterministic realiser is the fallback for every other source. Fact-id survival is the gate check.
routes.layer: domain proposition + realiser + gate; model restyle in infrastructure
routes.note: Strongest grounding story. It lines up with LineBrief, so build it as the same module.
